## Summary

**LSdQ** (Logical Shift Quad): 64 Bit shift left or right.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `b << a → d`<br>`b >> a → d` |
| Syntax | `LSLQ <vea>,b,d`<br>`LSRQ <vea>,b,d`<br>where &lt;vea&gt; modulo 64 = shift count |
| Short | 64 Bit shift left or right. |
| Description | LSdQ is a 64 Bit shift operation. The shift is modulo 64, the same as the 32bit variant. Zeroes are shifted into the LSB/MSB. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–1 | `0011100` |
| 2 | 0 | dir |

- Direction: 0=left 1=right

### Example

```asm
    lslq    d0,d1,d2
```

```text
vea d0: .. .. .. .. .. .. .. 0C   ( = decimal 12)
b d1: 01 23 45 67 89 AB CD EF
Result:
d d2: 34 56 78 9A BC DE F0 00
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no LSdQ. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
